title: ShieldCare Spoilage Allowance: the Share Met for Days Out of Use
content:
## The share

The share of the ceiling met for the days a covered appliance stood out of use under a Northbeam
ShieldCare Protection Plan rises with the length of the outage.

| Days the appliance stood out of use | The share met |
| --- | --- |
| more than 10 days | the whole of the ceiling, being 100 percent |
| more than 3 days and no more than 10 | 70 percent |
| every other claim | 40 percent |

## Both sides of the two thresholds

An outage of exactly 10 days is not more than 10, so it falls in the middle band at 70 percent, while
11 days reaches the whole of the ceiling. An outage of exactly 3 days is not more than 3, so it falls
to the bottom band at 40 percent, while 4 days reaches the middle band.

## Worked through on hypothetical figures

On a ceiling of 260.00:

| Days out of use | Share met | The ceiling at that share |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | 40 percent | 104.00 |
| 3 | 40 percent | 104.00 |
| 4 | 70 percent | 182.00 |
| 10 | 70 percent | 182.00 |
| 14 | 100 percent | 260.00 |
